description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. Polygons describe drainage, utility and sewer easements with type, effective date, expiry and ownership fields. The native layer exposes polygon geometry and named attributes, including EncumbranceType, EncumbranceDescription, EncumbranceOwner, ReferenceNumber, EffectiveDate, ExpirationDate. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for capacity planning studies. These legal constraints are distinct from physical asset geometry; recorded easements do not establish that infrastructure has been constructed. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
